content.question: What does fine-tuning achieve?
options: It makes the model forget the pre-training dataset completely.
It replaces the pre-trained patterns with brand-new ones.
It lets the model adapt to the nuances of the new dataset while retaining valuable information from pre-training.
It removes the need to evaluate the model on the new task.
content.answer: It lets the model adapt to the nuances of the new dataset while retaining valuable information from pre-training.
